concerns.text: The plan enforces a minimum of 200 samples per lead‑time/variable (Phase 1, step 3) as a hard cutoff, but provides no power analysis or justification that this sample size is sufficient to detect the expected calibration improvement, especially for rare‑event categories. Without a formal power calculation the study may be under‑powered, leading to inconclusive Diebold‑Mariano tests or unstable isotonic fits.
